client_separation.relationship: Separate client iteration with its own pinned copy of core 0.3.0; no shared runtime or courier merge

adapter: six scoped operations including explicit conditional retreat

inputs: host and recipient verified Tailscale IPv4 pins
recipient public key and independently confirmed SPKI fingerprint
encrypted envelope and independently confirmed envelope SHA-256

steps.action: Start dedicated broker; connect/login locally and release human controller
steps.secrets: MUD password uses stdin secret send; broker token and password never sent to recipient

steps.action: Enroll selected devices through official flows and restrict recipient-to-host TCP 8811

steps.retain: private receiving key for continuing authorized play

steps.action: Privately fill config.example.json; do not use documentation IPs or zero hash

steps.permission: Inspect any runtime connection request against exact agreed endpoint before approving; prepare send expiry only after warmup

condition.enemy_status: exact observed status line; 1..150 plain characters
condition.allow_afk_combat: explicit boolean; requires supported fresh same-enemy exchange before exact status and literal AFK prompt

steps.decision_id_mapping: command_id forwarded unchanged as core decision_id
steps.next_step: Inspect core result delivery, reason_code, original_decision, predicate_evidence and intervening_observation before a new decision

steps.action: Retain key and keep agreed game/broker/adapter running until scope changes; release ownership when handing off
runtime_requirements: fresh per-address CONNECT approval may be required

steps.action: After broker restart restore and authenticate intended character locally, release ownership and confirm the new broker lifetime before recipient reclaims
Disable scoped credential or stop adapter; rotate token to retire capability
steps.note: Does not undo an already admitted game command; envelope metadata is not enforced expiry

tests.network_scope: synthetic loopback only; helper sockets mocked

helper_outcomes.response_received: Parsed HTTP and JSON only; inspect HTTP status, returned error, receipt and observations. Exit 0 can include HTTP 4xx or 502.
helper_outcomes.not_sent: Inner MUD-adapter request was not sent; still refresh any expired or changed game decision.
helper_outcomes.uncertain: Stop and inspect; never blindly resend or substitute a new ID for the same uncertain command.
helper_outcomes.unknown: Unexpected exception, exit 1: stop and inspect; never assume nothing was sent.
helper_outcomes.unrecognized_malformed_or_missing: Stop and inspect; never permission to retry.

adapter_receipt_outcomes.broker_response: An ordinary or conditional core response arrived; inspect result.delivery and reason_code. This does not prove a game write or completion.
adapter_receipt_outcomes.not_forwarded: Adapter refused locally before forwarding the game operation.
adapter_receipt_outcomes.not_sent: Only a recognized versioned prewrite core error proves no game command write; inspect registered error_code.
adapter_receipt_outcomes.uncertain: No automatic retry or replacement ID; inspect observations and resolve the outcome.

http_409: May mean a local refusal, duplicate ID, busy adapter, or typed prewrite core refusal. Inspect the preserved receipt and error_code; status alone is insufficient.
http_502: Transport/journal failures and malformed, legacy or unrecognized broker errors remain uncertain; never classify delivery from English error text.
